en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a rural valley settlement beside a river, with traditional wooden farm buildings with turf roofs in the foreground and a small town spreading up a forested hillside in the background. At the bottom edge there is printed caption text identifying the location, and a small printed signature at the lower right, suggesting a photographic postcard.
